verse.text: Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.’”

reflection.scripture: Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.’”
reflection.observation: This is Jesus' response to Satan's temptation in the wilderness — after fasting 40 days, the devil challenged Him to turn stones into bread. Jesus doesn't argue or justify His hunger. He quotes Deuteronomy 8:3, reminding us that physical needs, while real, are not the deepest source of life. The word that sustains us comes from God Himself.
reflection.application: What are you “hungry” for today? Success? Validation? Security? It's easy to chase what seems urgent and neglect what truly nourishes. This verse invites us to pause and ask: Am I feeding my soul with God's Word, or just filling my schedule and stomach? Make space today — even five minutes — to read, reflect, and let Scripture speak into your life.
reflection.prayer: Lord, You know the hunger in my heart — the things I chase when I'm empty. Today, help me turn to Your Word first. Let it be the bread that sustains me, the truth that anchors me, and the voice that guides my steps. In Jesus' name, Amen.
